# hookforge

> 50 production Uniswap v4 hooks: novel AMM mechanisms, Solidity + Foundry, a TypeScript SDK, an MCP server for agents, and a 3D docs site. Base, Arbitrum, Unichain, Robinhood Chain.

hookforge is an open-source repository by nirholas, part of the three.ws ecosystem.
